info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Tiers-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Tier Retrieval API provides access to the various loyalty tiers within a loyalty program. This endpoint allows businesses to list all available loyalty tiers, facilitating customer engagement and rewards management. It is essential for applications that aim to showcase loyalty options to customers or for backend services that manage loyalty interactions. Typical consumers include mobile apps, web interfaces, and other systems that integrate loyalty features, ensuring users can easily understand their reward options.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details about the loyalty tier associated with a given customer or account. It provides insights into the tier level, benefits, and points accrued under the loyalty program.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve information about the loyalty tier.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the loyalty tier information is returned.
